title: Maximal Rectangle
inputFormat: Implement maximalRectangle(matrix). Receive a nonempty rectangular matrix of string characters "0" and "1", not numeric values.
outputFormat: Return the area of the largest all-ones rectangle, or 0 if no cell contains "1".
